## RM: Render Card — a sub-workflow

**Starts:** called by another workflow (RM · 3), never on its own.

TMDB details → branded 1080×1350 HTML → hcti.io → a hosted image URL.

Kept separate so the Instagram queue and anything else that needs a card share one renderer and one
look. Note the carousel path does **not** use this: it renders locally with Playwright, because seven
slides per post would burn the hcti.io quota.
